say:2:1730138502:1.text: *Coo-coo* Humans think all the time, yet they still die, don't they?
say:2:1730138502:1.source_cn: 咕咕，看那些习惯思考的人类，还不是消失了！
say:2:1730138502:1.male: *Coo-coo* Humans think all the time, yet they still die, don't they?
say:2:1730138502:1.female: *Coo-coo* Humans think all the time, yet they still die, don't they?

say:3:1730138503:1.text: *Coo-coo* Thinking won't put food in my belly!
say:3:1730138503:1.source_cn: 咕咕，思考可填不饱肚子！
say:3:1730138503:1.male: *Coo-coo* Thinking won't put food in my belly!
say:3:1730138503:1.female: *Coo-coo* Thinking won't put food in my belly!
